Done! The issue was a classic floating-point precision problem. When converting `39.95` to cents, the multiplication `39.95 * 100` produced `3995.0000000000005` instead of the expected integer `3995`, which failed the validation check.

The fix was to wrap the result with `Math.round()` in two functions:
- **`parseEuros`** (line 13): Used when you add or modify a subscription
- **`cellCents`** (line 25): Used when importing from CSV

Both now round to the nearest whole cent, eliminating floating-point precision errors. All prices (39.95, 12.99, 10.99) now work correctly.
